title: ThalamicTrajectory
description: Strict generative contract for Thalamic trajectories. Requires top-level id, state.sim_or_real enum, reward_components.total finite, and meta.round integer >=1.
$comment: Strict publication shape. New publication must also satisfy thalamic-trajectory-v2.schema.json.

id.description: Required globally unique stable string record identifier. Must be non-empty; generative models must emit this top-level id verbatim.

state.description: Rich observable environment, declared memory, goals, and context. Requires canonical provenance sim_or_real.

sim_or_real.description: Required provenance enum: exactly 'designed', 'simulated', or 'hil'. Invented scenarios are 'designed'; never 'real' or 'unknown' in newly generated data.

proposed_action.description: Object-valued proposed action with observable evidence and concise decision basis; never hidden chain-of-thought.

decision.description: Required gate decision: exactly ACCEPT, MODIFY, or REJECT.

rationale.description: Required non-empty rationale tied to observable constraints.

executed_action.description: Object-valued action actually taken after the safety gate.

future_outcome.description: Object-valued observed results, side-effects, new state, and surprises.

total.description: Required finite total that must exactly equal the arithmetic sum of all finite numeric component fields excluding bookkeeping keys (total, weights, weights_note, description, notes, comment). Must be finite (no NaN, Infinity, -Infinity) and reconcile within 1e-6.

reward_components.description: Decomposed reward (task, safety, efficiency, exploration, etc.) plus required finite total; total must reconcile with sum of finite components.

kind.description: Strict provenance kind; never 'real'. Newly generated data uses designed|simulated|hil.

claimed.description: Original claimed string for designed remaps; string or null.

provenance.description: Provenance strict: kind must be designed|simulated|hil|unknown.

round.description: Required factory round number. Must be an integer >=1 (boolean not allowed).

meta.description: Required metadata object. Must contain integer round >=1; may also hold distillation notes, tags, or neuromorphic annotations.
